analyzer_policy: Only explicitly registered project analyzers may plan source patches; no fixture fallback is used for arbitrary benchmarks.
known_limitations: Only explicitly registered project analyzers can produce source candidates.
Each non-fixture project needs an explicitly approved analyzer and, when required, PatchRuntimeProfile; no benchmark-specific analyzer or runtime command is inferred.
Structural edits and MCP/agent workflow are later stages.
Static adapter v1 constructor fingerprints use an explicit legacy compatibility path bounded by source span, callee and content fingerprint.
